title: Tissue Clearing Protocol for Uterus Tissues
author: Eunkyung Park
materials: Gradually dehydrate with MeOH/H2O (v/v) under the hood.
Refresh the 100% MeOH solution and then overnight.

steps.title: Fix Tissues
steps.instruction: Fix uterus tissues with 4% PFA overnight at 4°C and wash with PBS.

steps.title: Initial Clearing
steps.instruction: Cut tissue into approximately 5mm x 5mm x 5mm pieces and incubate in 1.8ml of CHAPS/NMDEA solution at 37°C for 2 days.

substeps.instruction: Prepare CHAPS/NMDEA solution consisting of 10% (wt/v) CHAPS (Sigma, #220201) and 25% (wt/v) NMDEA (Sigma, #471828) in diH2O.

steps.title: Wash Tissues
steps.instruction: Wash with 1X PBS at room temperature with rotation for 2 hours (3 times), then overnight.

steps.title: Dehydrate Tissues
steps.instruction: Perform sequential dehydration at room temperature under the hood using 10ml of the following solutions for 1 day each:

steps.title: Delipidate Tissues
steps.instruction: Delipidate with 10ml of DCM/MeOH (2:1, v/v) solution for 2 days.

steps.title: Rehydrate Tissues
steps.instruction: Perform sequential rehydration using 10ml of the following solutions for 1 day each:

steps.title: Acetic Acid Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove samples from diH2O and place in 10ml of acetic acid solution for 1 day at room temperature under the hood.

steps.title: Guanidine Treatment
steps.instruction: Wash twice with diH2O for 1 day at room temperature, then incubate with 10ml of guanidine solution for 1 day.

substeps.instruction: Prepare guanidine solution: 4M guanidine hydrochloride (Sigma, #3272), 0.05M sodium acetate, and 2% (wt/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS, pH 6.0.

steps.title: Second Wash
steps.instruction: Wash with 1X PBS at room temperature with rotation for 2 hours (3 times), then overnight.

steps.title: Block Tissues
steps.instruction: Block with 10% (v/v) goat serum, 10% (v/v) DMSO, and 0.2% (v/v) Triton X-100 in 1X PBS at 4°C on rotator for 3 days.

steps.title: Antibody Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate with conjugated antibody in antibody incubation buffer at 4°C on rotator for 14 days.

substeps.instruction: Prepare antibody incubation buffer: 3% (v/v) goat serum, 3% (v/v) DMSO, and 0.2% (v/v) Tween-20 in 1X PBS.
Use Alexa Fluor® 647 anti-Podoplanin (Lymphatic Endothelial Marker) Antibody, #916610.

steps.title: Post-Antibody Wash
steps.instruction: Wash with 0.1% Tween-20 in PBS at room temperature with rotation for 2 hours (3 times), then overnight.

steps.title: Embed Tissue
steps.instruction: Embed the tissue in 1% agarose gel/diH2O and cool for 3 hours.

steps.title: Methanol Dehydration
steps.instruction: Perform sequential dehydration using 10ml of the following solutions for 2 hours each:

steps.title: Refractive Index Matching
steps.instruction: Change to BABB/MeOH (1:1) for 5 hours, then perform RI matching with BABB solution for 1-4 days until the sample becomes completely transparent.

steps.title: Sample Mounting
steps.instruction: Place the sample in the imaging chamber and secure it using glue or screws.

substeps.instruction: Mount the chamber on the strip of a lightsheet microscope.

steps.title: Microscope Alignment
steps.instruction: Align the light sheet and configure imaging parameters.

substeps.instruction: Move the light sheet in xyz until the beam is centered on the target.
Determine channel and set the objective lens and zoom level.
Set the zero position and define the scan range from start to end.

steps.title: Image Acquisition
steps.instruction: Set the file to autosave and press the Start (play) button.

substeps.instruction: Double click the file, select output location, name the file, and save as format Imaris*.ims;*.ims.
